title: Moonlit Contract
author: Maya Sterling
description: A practical heiress agrees to a public engagement with a guarded billionaire, then discovers the contract hides a family mystery.
longDescription: Elena Ward thinks the engagement contract will protect her mother's company and end quietly after one season. Adrian Vale needs the arrangement to stop a hostile takeover and keep his private life sealed. Their careful rules begin to break when old letters, a midnight gala, and a missing heirloom point toward a secret both families buried years ago.
